diagnosis.narrative: The series carries a strong long-run trend. A moderate seasonal pattern is present. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (20 points, ~1% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.244), which favours a robust combination.
